intro: People have played for thousands of years. Greeks ran races at Olympia. People in Mexico built stone courts for a rubber ball. Each kind of play needed its own place.
Today we still build special places. Soccer uses a grass pitch. Basketball began in a gym in 1891. Races use a 400-meter track. Swimmers use pools, and hockey players use rinks.
Games also need turns everyone can see. A whistle, a starting line and a written team size help. You will learn who wrote those rules, and when.
bigQuestion: How do places and written rules help people share a game?
